name: PivotLine
description: A PivotLine object is a line of rows or columns in an Excel PivotTable.
remarks: PivotLines contain only visible items, so collapsed children of items and items in hidden levels are not present in the PivotLines collection. PivotLines always have a PivotItem in all positions. This means that the PivotLines representing subtotals in the PivotTable contain fewer PivotItems than regular PivotLines.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified PivotLine object. Read-only.

properties.name: LineType
properties.description: Returns an XlPivotLineType constant that indicates the type of PivotLine. Read-only.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the PivotLine object. Read-only.

properties.name: PivotLineCells
properties.description: Returns a collection of PivotCell objects in a PivotLine. Read-only.

properties.name: PivotLineCellsFull
properties.description: Retrieves all the PivotLine cells including those that are hidden in compact form. Read-only.
